reasons: The cited Section 11.1 provides automatic renewal for successive one (1) year periods with a mutual right to prevent renewal on thirty (30) days' written notice, which meets the preferred position's material terms (12-month renewal term, customer opt-out at 30 days) and is well inside the fallback 60-day ceiling.
No walk-away trigger is present: the five (5) year period is the negotiated initial term rather than an automatic multi-year renewal, and the notice window is far below 90 days.

The rationale correctly treats the absent vendor 60-day reminder and the absent CPI/3% uplift cap as minor preferred sub-elements noted but not redlined, consistent with the playbook's classification semantics.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraph.
The failed deterministic check ('number not found') is a regex artifact — the clause plainly states 'at least thirty (30) days prior' — so it does not undercut the substantive conclusion.
